name: Cellcom Israel
description: Israeli telecom operator offering mobile, fixed-line, internet and TV (Cellcom tv) services; one of the country's heaviest advertisers. Traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (CEL) and controlled by Discount Investment Corporation.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list); digital

notes: Agency history (Globes): budget (~NIS 25M) moved from Publicis to Reuveni-Pridan in Jul 2024; the sides split in Mar 2025 and Cellcom said it would work without a full-service agency, using K Agency for digital only. Subsidiaries Golan Telecom and Dynamica are handled by Glickman-Shamir-Samsonov (2025). Feb 2026 (Globes): Cellcom ended its short project-based work with ID.EA; under CEO Eli Adadi it buys TV media directly and works per project, with no agency of record confirmed. Agency status as of 2026-02.
